title: dryopteris gardneriana
intro: Dryopteris gardneriana, commonly known as the Chinese shield fern, is a species of fern native to China and Southeast Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris gardneriana include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects, which may aid in relieving pain, reducing muscle spasms, and promoting urine production. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, lignans, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
